title: Public tables without Row Level Security
description: Catalog reports two public tables with RLS disabled: data_requests and tenant_isolation_quarantine.
root_cause: RLS not enabled on compliance/quarantine tables; server routes use service role for inserts.
intended_behavior: Compliance submissions stored with restricted read access; quarantine table internal-only.

trace.description: Inserts into data_requests using service role client
Lists data_requests among RLS disabled tables

existing_protection: Service role used server-side; not direct browser insert
why_protection_may_fail: If PostgREST grants SELECT to anon/authenticated, table becomes readable without app layer
recommended_remediation: Deploy pending RLS migration after grant audit; verify no anon SELECT
regression_test: Assert anon key cannot SELECT from data_requests

title: Client portal JWT signing may fall back to service role material
description: Portal session HMAC secret selection includes SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as a candidate env var.
root_cause: Shared secret candidate list couples portal cookie integrity with DB admin credential class.

trace.description: Iterates SHARED_SECRET_CANDIDATE_ENVS including service role key

evidence.summary: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY listed as signing secret fallback

existing_protection: Production throws if no 32+ byte secret from any candidate
why_protection_may_fail: Operational mistake setting only service role env collapses secrets
recommended_remediation: Remove service role from candidate list; require dedicated portal secret
regression_test: Startup fails in prod without CLIENT_PORTAL_SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET

title: API rate limits degrade to per-instance memory when Redis absent
description: rateLimitMiddleware falls back to in-memory Map — limits not shared across Railway replicas.
intended_behavior: Distributed rate limiting for auth and API abuse prevention.

trace.description: Documented fallback when Redis not configured

evidence.summary: WARNING: will not work across multiple server instances

existing_protection: Cloudflare edge limits may still apply (out of repo)
why_protection_may_fail: Attacker rotates across instances to multiply effective quota
recommended_remediation: Require Redis in production; alert if fallback active
regression_test: Health check exposes redis backend active in prod

title: Large MCP write surface with limited verification metadata
description: Exposure report: 349 write tools, 189 external action tools, 6 with verification support.
unresolved_fact: Whether production OAuth tokens are scoped narrowly enough to make rare tools unreachable in practice
recommended_remediation: Tier tools; default deny high-risk writes without approval + idempotency

title: Cross-client document access via documentId manipulation
unresolved_fact: Whether requireClientPortalAccessDoubleGuarded enforces client_id match on document row for all finance routes
recommended_remediation: Playwright test client A cannot fetch client B documentId

title: npm critical advisory on next package
unresolved_fact: Whether advisory applies to Linux Railway deployment on next@16.2.12
recommended_remediation: Upgrade Next per vendor guidance after CI validation

title: Spoof x-railway-cron to invoke cron routes in production
description: Rejected: production requires Bearer CRON_SECRET; header alone insufficient.

title: 78 API routes have no authentication
description: Rejected: heuristic false positives; client-finance uses double guard.
